name: vault
description: Encrypted credential store (AES-256-GCM in SQLite) with audit logging — secrets out of code and env files.
env_example: # Master key for AES-256-GCM. Generate: openssl rand -hex 32
# WARNING: losing this key makes every stored credential unrecoverable.
post_install: Set VAULT_KEY in .env (openssl rand -hex 32). Back it up somewhere safe — it cannot be recovered.
Restart the platform: docker compose restart endpoint-platform (applies migration 002_vault.sql).
Store credentials with PUT /api/vault/credentials/<service>; reads are audit-logged.
The vault is only as protected as the platform port: keep it loopback-only or behind an allowlist proxy.
